proof_body:
by
  intro α β m n
  induction n generalizing m with
  | zero =>
    have h := intervalIntegral.integral_comp_sub_right (a := α) (b := β) (fun y : ℝ => y ^ m) α
    simp only [pow_zero, mul_one]
    rw [h, integral_pow]
    have hf : ((m + 0 + 1).factorial : ℝ) = (m + 1 : ℝ) * (m.factorial : ℝ) := by
      simp [Nat.factorial_succ]
    have hm : (m.factorial : ℝ) ≠ 0 := by positivity
    have hm1 : (m + 1 : ℝ) ≠ 0 := by positivity
    simp only [sub_self, Nat.factorial_zero, mul_one, one_mul, add_zero]
    rw [show ((m + 1).factorial : ℝ) = (m + 1 : ℝ) * (m.factorial : ℝ) by simp [Nat.factorial_succ]]
    rw [zero_pow (by omega)]
    field_simp
    ring
  | succ n ih =>
    have hm1 : (m + 1 : ℝ) ≠ 0 := by positivity
    have key := intervalIntegral.integral_mul_deriv_eq_deriv_mul
      (a := α) (b := β)
      (u := fun x : ℝ => (x - β) ^ (n + 1))
      (v := fun x : ℝ => (x - α) ^ (m + 1) / (m + 1 : ℝ))
      (u' := fun x : ℝ => ((n + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) * (x - β) ^ n)
      (v' := fun x : ℝ => (x - α) ^ m)
      (fun x _ => by
        have := ((hasDerivAt_id' x).sub_const β).fun_pow (n + 1)
        simpa using this)
      (fun x _ => by
        have := (((hasDerivAt_id' x).sub_const α).fun_pow (m + 1)).div_const (m + 1 : ℝ)
        convert this using 1
        simp only [Nat.add_sub_cancel, Nat.cast_add, Nat.cast_one, mul_one]
        field_simp)
      (by apply Continuous.intervalIntegrable; fun_prop)
      (by apply Continuous.intervalIntegrable; fun_prop)
    have e1 : (∫ x in α..β, (x - α) ^ m * (x - β) ^ (n + 1)) = ∫ x in α..β, (x - β) ^ (n + 1) * (x - α) ^ m := by
      congr 1; ext x; ring
    have e2 : (∫ x in α..β, ((n + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) * (x - β) ^ n * ((x - α) ^ (m + 1) / (m + 1 : ℝ))) = ((n + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) / (m + 1 : ℝ) * ∫ x in α..β, (x - α) ^ (m + 1) * (x - β) ^ n := by
      rw [← intervalIntegral.integral_const_mul]
      congr 1; ext x; field_simp
    rw [e1, key, e2, ih (m + 1)]
    have hf : ((m + 1 + n + 1).factorial : ℝ) = ((m + (n + 1) + 1).factorial : ℝ) := by
      congr 2; omega
    have hp : (β - α) ^ (m + 1 + n + 1) = (β - α) ^ (m + (n + 1) + 1) := by
      congr 1; omega
    rw [hf, hp]
    have hF : ((m + (n + 1) + 1).factorial : ℝ) ≠ 0 := by positivity
    simp only [sub_self, zero_div, mul_zero, ne_eq, zero_pow, zero_mul, sub_zero, Nat.factorial_succ, Nat.cast_mul, Nat.cast_add, Nat.cast_one, pow_succ]
    field_simp
    ring
target_source: ∀ (α β : ℝ) (m n : ℕ), (∫ x in α..β, (x - α) ^ m * (x - β) ^ n) = (-1 : ℝ) ^ n * ((m.factorial * n.factorial : ℕ) : ℝ) / ((m + n + 1).factorial : ℝ) * (β - α) ^ (m + n + 1)
